aal.name: AAL116 — native Colin27
aal.sourceDistribution: 2015 SPM12 original files preserved by Neurita/std_brains mirror
aal.license: GNU GPL; this distribution elects GPL-3.0 (author README specifies no version)
aal.licenseStatus: GPL grant in preserved original README; complete available source and full GPL supplied
aal.note: 116 original positive label IDs (2001–9170), preserved without renumbering. Native atlas; no FSL overlay without an explicitly reviewed transform.

registeredCandidate.name: AAL116 — FSL registration candidate
registeredCandidate.license: GNU GPL; this distribution elects GPL-3.0 (author README specifies no version)
registeredCandidate.note: 项目估计配准：2mm变换场，1mm标签采样；保留全部标签，不代表1mm定位精度。三正交中心切片经AI核图；并非官方变换或人工解剖认证。2mm采样会丢失AAL3标签134。
limitations: Project estimated transform, not an official GIN/FSL transform.
1mm label grid uses a field estimated at2mm; output spacing does not imply spatial accuracy.
2mm output loses label134; 1mm output retains all116/166 labels.
Exploratory reference/ROI view only; individual small nuclei need independent anatomical review.

aal3.name: AAL3 — native Colin27 (2020 atlas geometry)
aal3.sourceDistribution: NIH AFNI distribution of GIN AAL3v1; 2024 AAL3v2 guide states atlas geometry unchanged
aal3.license: GNU GPL; this distribution elects GPL-3.0 (author guide specifies no version)
aal3.licenseStatus: Primary guide states GPL and unchanged v1 geometry; NIH original data and full GPL supplied; exact2024 README not acquired
aal3.note: 166 positive regions at 1 mm; original IDs 1–170 with 35,36,81,82 absent. Small nuclei are template labels, not subject-specific localization.
